caption: The drawing depicts a round, three-legged cast iron cauldron with a wide body and a slightly flared rim. The cauldron has a single, thick, curved handle attached on either side at the rim, arching above the vessel's opening. The surface of the cauldron appears textured, suggesting a rough, cast iron material, and there are visible horizontal bands encircling the upper and lower parts of its body for structural reinforcement. The cauldron is marked with faint, raised letters near the upper part that appear to read "LLAD". The drawing is rendered in black and white, with shading used to suggest depth, shadow, and the roundness of the object, set against a plain, light-colored background without any additional objects.
